title: Founders of Washington copied Egypt with obelisks
place_text: Washington DC; Central Park; France; England

tellings.quote: he explained to me what they knew and how the the people that set Washington up, they did the same thing.

plain: The people who laid out Washington DC are said to have copied ancient Egypt on purpose, putting up obelisks as the Egyptians did, the same as was done in Central Park, France and England. Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs show up around him, repeats this from a man named Robert Gilbert, who he says "explained to me what they knew and how the people that set Washington up, they did the same thing." If true, it would mean the capital was built on an old, deliberate design.
